ddl.name: group_invitations_response_consistency_check
ddl.value: ("status" IN ('ACCEPTED', 'DECLINED') AND "responded_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'EXPIRED') AND "responded_at" IS NULL)

ddl.name: group_members_joined_at_consistency_check
ddl.value: ("status" = 'ACCEPTED' AND "joined_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" <> 'ACCEPTED' AND "joined_at" IS NULL)

ddl.name: group_members_left_at_consistency_check
ddl.value: "left_at" IS NULL OR ("status" = 'ACCEPTED' AND "joined_at" IS NOT NULL AND "left_at" >= "joined_at")

ddl.name: settlements_confirmation_consistency_check
ddl.value: ("status" = 'CONFIRMED' AND "confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" <> 'CONFIRMED' AND "confirmed_at" IS NULL)
